title: Reopening a completed work order leaves its inactive part inactive
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), a role that has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Create & Edit' and 'Delete'.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-REOPEN-01) is tracked at {Location-A}.
  • Work order {Work-order-1} (for example S2-15440) is complete, not invoiced, and its line {Line-1} (for example "ZZAUTOTEST PL REOPEN line") holds {Part-A}.
  • {Part-A} was set inactive after the work order was completed.
custom_steps:
1. Open {Work-order-1} and reopen it (its header ⋮ menu → "Uncomplete").
  2. Go to Parts → Inventory, click the Inactive tab and search {Part-A}.
  3. Click the Active tab and search {Part-A}.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: {Work-order-1} is no longer complete and still shows {Part-A} on {Line-1}.
  • Step 2: {Part-A} is still listed on the Inactive tab.
  • Step 3: {Part-A} is not on the Active tab.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10822 (Story 9, Inactive Parts Cannot Be Added to New Work); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, as edited 9 Oct 2026 (Ready for dev), S9-E5, read 13 Oct 2026; design canvas 13 Oct copy: no board shows this. Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)
